cover_letter:
Dear Foxelli Team,

I'm writing to apply for the CRO Specialist position. Your emphasis on thoughtful experimentation, AI, and building products customers love aligns with how I approach digital marketing: test, learn, and improve continuously.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and content publishing for client websites. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I track performance with Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads. This data-driven work has taught me to identify opportunities, form hypotheses, and measure outcomes—skills that directly translate to CRO. On my personal project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits, which improved search visibility across both traditional and AI-powered engines. I also collaborated with designers and developers to bring the site to life, giving me firsthand experience in cross-functional execution.

While I haven't run formal A/B tests in a commercial e-commerce setting, I'm deeply curious about conversion optimization and eager to apply my analytical mindset to plan and prioritize experiments. I'm comfortable working with data, learning new tools, and taking ownership of outcomes. I thrive in collaborative environments and communicate clearly with stakeholders.

Foxelli's culture of learning, automation, and meaningful work is exactly where I want to grow. I'm excited about the chance to contribute to your brands' conversion performance and to learn from your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to Foxelli.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
